package.name: sim_supervisor
package.description: sim_supervisor_node — the sim uDV emulator. Simulates the role the IFS-08 uDV (micro-ROS endpoint) plays on the real car: it owns the AS state machine (publishing /assi/state + /ami/mission), relays mission_control's /ctrl/cmd (Twist) to the bridge, serves /force_ebs, and emulates the uDV's /odom. It speaks the stock-typed interface in mission_control.interface_contract, so mission_control runs identical code in sim and on the car. The sim operator panel (AMI + RES) is driven by the backend/CLI over /sim/* topics. On the real car this node does not run; the physical uDV plays that role instead.
